title: Another Name
text: So, after saying goodbye to the Big Sisters, I headed to see the Hermit. He seemed to have had a good rest at the hot springs, as he was sitting in his room looking quite relaxed.
“Hermit, I’m back.”
“Oh, Spear Hero. How did the hunt on Cal Mira Island go?”
“Absolutely no problems at all! Both White Swan and Kou have leveled up sufficiently. Now it’s just a matter of watching them grow.”
“Hmm! So… when do you think White Swan will change her form? I still haven’t been able to tell for certain.”
“That’s true… I think it’s about time to ask Filolial-sama to change her form. She should be able to speak as well.”

Thanks to years of intuition, I’ve come to have a fairly good grasp of the timing when Filolial-sama will take on the form of an angel and be able to speak. By the way, White Swan wanted to do a little running on the sandy beach, so I let her do as she pleased. It also seemed like she was checking on her own growth. Compared to Yuki-chan, Filolial-sama is truly stoic, isn’t she?

That must have been the form Yuki-chan was originally meant to take—the White Swan. If I were to meet Yuki-chan again in another loop, I might need to prepare an environment where she can run even more. That’s how much White Swan seems to love running, after all.
“Pee!”
Kou is hopping along behind me. By the way, he’s very attached to Big Sister, and even now he wants to go play with her.
“Shall we head over to White Swan right away?”
“Hmm. Though… judging by the Fleon incident, we’ll need to prepare some clothes.”
“That’s right. We should see her in person at the warehouse where we’ve stored the equipment we brought.”

So, after calling out to White Swan—who was doing some sprint training on the sandy beach—we made our way to the stable where the inn had prepared a carriage for us. There, I turned toward White Swan and clasped my hands together in prayer.
“Filolial-sama, Filolial-sama, please, I beg you to show me your angelic form.”
“Kue!”

White Swan didn’t even seem to tilt her head; she simply nodded as if granting my wish and transformed into an angel. However… well. Most of the Filolial-samas I raise tend to have physiques very similar to Filo-tan’s. But for some reason, White Swan descended in the form of a mature woman.

Her hair was long and sleek, and her skin was as pure as snow. Her features were perfectly proportioned, and she was a beauty who could easily rival even the most stunning of Big Sisters. She even has a figure.
You know what I mean. To put it simply, there stood a beautiful woman with the sharp, ethereal quality of a snow woman, wings attached to her back.
“What do you think? Motoyasu-sama, Immortal. What do you think of my appearance?”
“W-well now… she’s quite the stunner…”
The Immortal praised White Swan while averting his gaze, as if unsure where to look.
“She’s absolutely gorgeous!”
She’s turned out to be exactly the kind of beauty I imagined Yuki-chan would become when she grew up.
“I did it! Though… I’m not quite used to moving in this form yet.”
White Swan opens and closes her hands, as if testing how her body feels.
“So, Motoyasu-sama, I’ve shown you the form you requested. What should I do next?”
“I’m going to make some clothes, so I’d like you to use the equipment that turns Magical Power into thread.”
“Understood.”
When I point to the equipment, White Swan asks how to use it and starts operating it.
“I think it would be great if I could turn my Magical Power into thread while running.”
Her thoughts on this differ from Yuki-chan’s. She must really love running.
“So, Motoyasu-sama, and you, Immortal.”
“What is it?”
“What is it?”
“You do know that my name, White Swan, is my racing name at the ranch, don’t you?”
That’s certainly true.
“As I take on this new world… I’d like a new name to symbolize my growth.”

Oh? A name change at this point? Well, in some places where Filolial-sama competes, there’s a system where they have a “childhood name,” and when registering for a race, they’re given a new name. White Swan is probably seeking a new name based on that understanding.

“Motoyasu, you said that when you took a liking to me on the ship during our journey, it was from a version of me with a different possibility, didn’t you? I… seek a name as a subordinate of Lord Motoyasu.”
“So, you want the Spear Hero to give you a name from an alternate future?”
When the Immortal asked this, White Swan nodded.
“That’s right. Lord Motoyasu, I’d like you to tell me the name you know for me.”

It’s true that I did mention Yuki-chan during our journey, but I didn’t actually say her name. It seems White Swan is seeking a name as proof that she has been chosen. I understand. I, Motoyasu, intend to do my utmost to fulfill whatever Filolial-sama requests.
“Understood! White Swan. From now on, you’ll be known as Yuki!”
“Yuki, then! I understand!”
White Swan—now Yuki-chan—flashes a joyful smile.
“It’s true, just as Lord Motoyasu said—I’m brimming with power like never before since I was chosen, and I can move at an astonishing speed. I’m going to get even faster!”

With that, Yuki-chan kept operating the machine that turns Magical Power into thread, producing enough thread to make a dress. Now then… what kind of outfit would suit Yuki-chan best this time? Honestly, I feel like Yuki-chan, with her long hair, would look absolutely stunning in a traditional Japanese kimono. A yuki-onna motif would be the perfect fit.
“So, as long as I’m careful not to tear the clothes, I don’t need to turn my Magical Power into thread, right? Master Immortal?”
“That is true, but…”
“Then please prepare some clothes for a woman with the same build as me. I’ll wear them with style. It’s just like the koshihikari, isn’t it?”

Sometimes, the winner’s feather in the Filolial Race is adorned with a “keshō-mawashi.” It certainly does look good on her… but Yuki-chan is probably equating that “keshō-mawashi” with the actual clothing itself.
“I think her instinct is correct… hmm. It seems this is how a Filolial raised on competitive feathers perceives things when we communicate.”
“So, we need to prepare some clothes. I’ll make the arrangements right away, then.”
So, I spoke with the hotel staff and obtained some clothes from the inn’s wardrobe that I thought would suit Yuki-chan. Now it’s time to rush to have the kimono made.
“What do you think, Motoyasu-sama?”
Yuki-chan, looking slender and graceful, showed me how the outfit looked on her.
“It suits you very well.”
“I’m so happy!”
Yuki-chan is skipping along, looking very happy.
“So, Lord Motoyasu, what are your plans from here on out? I intend to do exactly as you command.”
“I have very high hopes for you, Yuki-chan. First, we’ll be raising a large number of Filolial-sama, and I’m entrusting you with assisting and directing that effort.”
“Yuki will fulfill her mission exactly as you command, Motoyasu-sama! I’ll make sure all the Filolials you raise grow into splendid competitive birds, won’t I?”
Huh? The direction of this request is a bit different from the Yuki-chan I know.
“That’s not it. You must raise the Filolial-sama just as they are… freely and naturally, following your instincts. Yuki-chan, you’re still bound by your repressed past self, aren’t you?”
“My apologies. If I do as Motoyasu says, I’ll be able to reach even greater heights… I must try not to think about the race, mustn’t I?”
“You’re very quick to understand, which is a relief… Though, you’re right—it might actually be better than pushing yourself too hard.”
“Piyo!”

It was a truly memorable moment—Yuki-chan full of enthusiasm and Kou chirping cheerfully. And so, our first day on Cal Mira Island came to an end. We could have stayed at an inn on the island we visited, but a day trip was plenty. On the other hand, Big Sister seemed a bit anxious at the inn—perhaps because Father was staying at an inn on the island he’d visited. Incidentally, I heard that Big Sister’s older sister was drinking at a tavern. And so, it’s the second day.
“Big Sisters, what shall we do today?”
I spoke to my Big Sister at the inn and asked her what we should do next.
“Shall we go hunting until we meet up with Father? Or should we rest at the inn?”
“Um…”
My Big Sister turned her gaze toward Yuki-chan, who was sitting next to me.
“Please excuse me for interrupting. I’m a Filolial who, until yesterday, was known as White Swan. I’ve since asked Motoyasu-sama to change my name, and I’m now called Yuki.”
“Oh… is that so…? Come to think of it, that Filolial named Black Thunder also looked different from the rest of the Filolials, didn’t she?”
“That’s true. It’s a fact that the Yuki-chan I knew had a build similar to Filo-tan’s.”
Big Sister’s observation is only natural. Filo-tan is Sakura-chan… or rather, even among the Sakura-chans, some are bigger than others. I suppose this is one of the drawbacks of the loop.
“I suppose I should introduce myself again. My name is Raphtalia, Yuki-san.”
“It’s a pleasure to meet you.”
My Big Sister and Yuki-chan were shaking hands. There’s no doubt that Yuki-chan will take a liking to my Big Sister.
“So, Big Sister, getting back to the topic at hand, what should we do?”

“It would be a problem if we ran into Naofumi-sama by chance… and since the Spear Hero said he wanted to train Filolial, we’ll stand by here. You’ve already told me pretty much everything I need to relay to Naofumi-sama, so I think we’ve had enough interaction for now.”
“We can always catch up later. I’ll talk to my Father as much as I can, too.”
I’m always open to talking with my Father. So, with this unexpected free time, today’s a great day to raise the newly hatched Filolial-sama!
“Alright then, Yuki-chan, today we’ll raise the newly hatched Filolial-sama!”
Luna-chan hatched this morning as well. Speaking of Luna-chan, Keel isn’t here. Once he returns from the island, he’ll likely be recruited right away for Father’s development project.
“Got it!”
“Gua!”
Kou has grown quite a bit and was rubbing up against his Big Sister.
“Um, Spear Hero? Who is this little one?”
“Kou is very attached to Big Sister, so I’ll leave him in your care.”
“Well… I’m not sure I can handle that.”
“But Kou is very attached to Big Sister, your late friend, and the Elephant, after all.”

Big Sister was looking at me with a pensive expression—I wonder what’s wrong? Come to think of it, Rival mentioned the other day that when he looped back to the first world, he told his Father—who didn’t quite get it—that “there is hope.” I suppose something must be up.
“Elephant, huh?”
“Big Sister’s older sister might know him, too. I hear she’s a warrior from Zeltoble.”
“I wonder if it’s Elmelo-chan?”
“Anyway, Kou is reliable, so I’m counting on him. Would that be okay as today’s request?”
“Ah… I see. Let’s compromise and consider this a chance to bond. Well then, Kou, you seem hungry, so I’ll go prepare some food for you.”
“Gua!”

So, after leaving Kou in the care of my Big Sisters, Yuki-chan and I worked on raising a new Filolial-sama until snack time. Nothing else of note happened on the second day. In the first world, that incident would’ve gotten me scolded by my Big Sisters, but this time, she didn’t seem particularly upset about it.
“Motoyasu, I heard from Raphtalia—did you… leave Filolial with Raphtalia?”

After hearing the details from my Big Sister, my father came over to speak with me. My Big Sister was talking a short distance away, seemingly exchanging words with Kou and Filolial. It seems she’s asking Filo-tan what she was doing with my father-in-law.
“That’s right. Kou is Filolial-sama, after all, and he gets along well with my Big Sister.”
“Are you finally planning to brainwash even Raphtalia?”
Oh? My father-in-law says this with a hint of wariness.
“Brainwash? I have no such intention. I just introduced them because Kou’s a bit of a mama’s boy and got along well with my Big Sister.”
“I’ll be the judge of that… I won’t forgive you if you do anything strange to Raphtalia.”
“Hey, hey, Motoyasu-chan, isn’t there a Filolial-sama who gets along well with your Big Sister?”
I ponder the question from my Big Sister’s Big Sister. …Come to think of it, I don’t recall any Filolial-sama who’s particularly close to my Big Sister’s Big Sister.
“If possible, I’d prefer someone who can hold her liquor.”
“Unfortunately, I don’t recall any. I’m afraid I can’t help you there.”

When it comes to my Big Sister’s Big Sister, my most vivid memory is of her drinking with my Father; as for her relationship with Filolial-sama, it just seems like she gets along with them smoothly and takes good care of them. At most, maybe Chick… but even then, I think their relationship was more like that of coworkers.
“Oh, what a shame.”

It’s very rare for Filolial-sama to enjoy a drink, after all. Chick and Midori seemed to be able to hold their liquor, though. After all, Chick and Midori are Filolial-sama who can wield the Poison element. Even so, it’s easy to imagine that it would have been difficult for them to keep up with my Big Sister when drinking.
